search.rules: Search rules by text or category…
search.tagrules: Search rules by text or tag…
search.label: Search

c.title: Categories
c.desc: Click a category to see its activity. Deleting one never deletes transactions.
c.starter: Starter set: adds common categories (bills, insurance, health, car, income) and starter rules for Israeli stores, in English and Hebrew. Nothing you already have is changed.
c.renText: Changes it on every transaction, rule, budget, bill and jar. If a category with the new name already exists, the two become one.
c.delQ: Delete "{k}"? Its transactions become uncategorized, and its rules and budget are removed.
c.addedSorted: Added {c} categories and {r} rules, and sorted {n} uncategorized transaction | Added {c} categories and {r} rules, and sorted {n} uncategorized transactions

g.title: Tags
g.desc: Click a tag to see its activity. Rename a tag to change it everywhere; renaming it to a tag that exists merges the two. Deleting a tag never deletes transactions.
g.byRule: {n} transaction · added by a rule | {n} transactions · added by a rule
g.appear: Tags appear here once a transaction has one. Add tags when you open a transaction, or let a tag rule add them automatically.
g.renText: Changes it on every transaction and in every tag rule. If a tag with the new name already exists, they become one.
g.delQ: Delete the tag "{g}"? It is removed from {n} transaction and from tag rules. The transactions stay. | Delete the tag "{g}"? It is removed from {n} transactions and from tag rules. The transactions stay.

r.title: Category rules
r.desc: If a new transaction's description contains the text, it gets that category. The first matching rule wins, and a category you set by hand is never changed.
r.none: No rules yet. Add one below, or add the suggested ones in the Categories tab.
r.dup: There is already a rule for that text
r.added: Rule added. {n} uncategorized transaction now in {c}. | Rule added. {n} uncategorized transactions now in {c}.
r.addedNew: Rule added. It applies to new transactions.
r.newGo: New transactions with "{k}" now go to {c}.
r.move: Move {n} past transaction too | Move {n} past transactions too

tr.title: Tag rules
tr.desc: If a new transaction's description contains the text, it gets these tags. Tags are added on top of the category, and a rule can add several. When you add a rule you can also tag the transactions you already have.
tr.none: No tag rules yet. Add one below. Example: “netflix” adds the tag “streaming”.
tr.last: A tag rule needs at least one tag. Delete the rule instead.
tr.addedNew: Rule added. New transactions that contain “{k}” get {tags}.
tr.updatedNone: Rule updated. No other transactions need the tag.
tr.from: From now on, new transactions that contain “{k}” get
tr.have: transaction you already have matches. | transactions you already have match.

n.title: Name rules
n.desc: Give entries a clearer display name. Only what you see changes: the bank's own text, your rules and your reports still use the original. The first matching rule wins, and a name you give one entry by hand always wins. To name one entry, open it and use Display name.
n.name: Name
n.none: No name rules yet. Example: if Memo contains “Acme Ltd” → Salary.
n.needBoth: Type the text to match and the name
n.needBothEdit: A name rule needs text to match and a name

gen.cardDesc: If a payment from your bank contains the text, it is the bill of a credit card. It is not counted as spending, because each purchase is already counted on the card.
gen.cardNone: No rules of your own yet. Mark one card payment in Activity and the app offers to create one for you, or add one below.
gen.cardPh: Text from the bank line, for example ישראכרט חיוב
gen.cardAuto: Recognised automatically, with no rule: {list}. Also any bank payment equal to what a card was charged on that day.
gen.cardShort: Type some text from the bank line, for example “ישראכרט חיוב”.
gen.salDesc: If an income contains the text (in its description or the payer), it is marked as Salary when it has no category yet.
gen.salNone: No rules of your own yet. Add the name of your employer below.
gen.salPh: Payer or text, for example wix
gen.salAuto: Recognised automatically, with no rule: income that says משכורת, שכר, salary or payroll, and the same payer paying a similar amount every month for three months or more.
gen.salShort: Type text from the payer or the description, for example “wix”.
gen.salAdded: Rule added. {n} existing income entry is now Salary. | Rule added. {n} existing income entries are now Salary.
gen.salAddedNew: Rule added. Future income like this is marked as Salary.
